title: Beautiful and thick glass..not flimsy.
text: Beautiful and thick glass..not flimsy.. I love this vase. It comes in a very well packed box. It is a beautiful light blue glass color with a tan rope design tied on the outside. The opening hole on top is about 1 inch wide so I dont think it will hold a lot of thick stemmed flowers. Im going to put colored sand layers in mine with silk flowers. It just has such a nice rustic look to it.
